- $I$ = index set of all dairy products (from column "Full_Product_Name" in table_id file_0_view_0)

$$

$$
x_i \leq d_i \quad \forall i \in I
$$

- Variable domain:

    vals = rec['values']
    prod = vals['Full_Product_Name']
    try:
        rev = float(vals['Revenue'])
        dem = int(vals['Demand'])
        inv = int(vals['Initial Inventory'])
    except Exception as e:

    inventory[prod] = inv
